Date: 2020-04-29 What is claimed is:
1. An ablation system, comprising:
an ablation catheter comprising a distal portion configured to deliver energy to tissue;
a diagnostic catheter comprising:
an elongate shaft configured to slidingly receive the distal portion of the ablation catheter shaft, and
an array coupled to the diagnostic catheter shaft and comprising a plurality of ultrasound transducers and a plurality of electrodes, wherein the plurality of electrodes is configured to sense electrical cardiac information;
a distance measurement assembly configured to drive the plurality of ultrasound transducers to produce anatomical geometry data; and
a processing unit configured to generate a three-dimensional map of the anatomical cavity using the anatomical geometry data, to generate cardiac mapping information from sensed electrical cardiac information, including dipole density information, and to drive a display to output at least some of the cardiac mapping information and the distal portion of the ablation catheter in conjunction with the three-dimensional map of the anatomical cavity. 51
